inputs.name: Unique valuation and completeness of finite extensions of Q_ell
inputs.statement_used: Every finite extension E/Q_ell has a unique extended nonarchimedean absolute value, is complete, and satisfies |x|_E^[E:Q_ell]=|Norm_E/Q_ell(x)|_ell. The absolute value extends uniquely to the algebraic closure.
matching: The field is the actual finite intermediate field inside PadicAlgCl(ell), with the unique extended valuation, at every prime including 2.
Completeness makes each finite intermediate field closed in the noncomplete algebraic closure.
RV6 proves the integral unit-ball equality, finite trace-dual lattice, discrete valuation ring and fraction field facts needed for the coefficient ring.
RV4 proves the Krasner comparison and the countable cover, then proves the needed compact Baire argument and cocycle subgroup capture. They are not additional retained inputs.

proved_here_not_retained_as_additional_l.name: Prime-power cyclotomic degree
proved_here_not_retained_as_additional_l.proof: RV3: shift sum_{j=0}^{ell-1} X^(j ell^(r-1)) by one and apply the explicitly checked Eisenstein criterion.
proved_here_not_retained_as_additional_l.comparison_reference: Milne, Algebraic Number Theory, Proposition 6.2(a), printed p.96.

proved_here_not_retained_as_additional_l.name: Krasner containment
proved_here_not_retained_as_additional_l.proof: RV4: unique absolute value makes automorphisms isometries; the strict conjugate separation forces an automorphism fixing beta to fix alpha.
proved_here_not_retained_as_additional_l.comparison_reference: Milne, Algebraic Number Theory, Proposition 7.60, printed pp.131-132.

proved_here_not_retained_as_additional_l.name: Countable finite-field cover and Baire cocycle capture
proved_here_not_retained_as_additional_l.proof: RV4: rational coefficient approximation, countable embedded Qbar, closed subgroups supplied by the cocycle equation, an open subgroup from compact Baire, and finite coset representatives.

proved_here_not_retained_as_additional_l.name: Finite-length Selmer to vector vanishing
proved_here_not_retained_as_additional_l.proof: RV5: finite-length annihilation, scaled quotient cocycles and one exact witness obtained from a single nontrivial scalar.

inherited_human_suppliers.LD3: Compatible finite global Poitou-Tate duality, with its matched classical input.
inherited_human_suppliers.LK2: Native finite-local-field cohomology finiteness, with its matched classical input.
inherited_human_suppliers.LK3: Native finite-local-field Tate duality and actual cup/invariant identification.
inherited_human_suppliers.KB1: Original compact cochains, finite global cohomology and inverse-limit comparison.
inherited_human_suppliers.KB6: Original valuation/henselization/completion to native local-field transport.
inherited_human_suppliers.KB8: Literal LemmaK31, with its recorded K-theory and other classical leaves.

not_required: Ferrero-Washington or an Iwasawa control theorem
A prime-to-ell order hypothesis on the finite character
Any automorphy, rigidity, trace-counting or CorX supplier
